title: Minutes of the annual general meeting
summary: Records the annual general meeting: who was present, the statements received and the resolutions passed.

fields.name: present
fields.label: Who was present, one a line

fields.name: fy_end
fields.label: The financial year whose statements it received

fields.name: resolutions
fields.label: The resolutions passed, one a line

paragraphs: The annual general meeting of {{.Company.Name}} was held at {{.F.place}} on {{.F.meeting_on}} at {{.F.time}}.

sections.heading: Chair
paragraphs: {{.F.chair}} chaired the meeting. A quorum being present, the chair declared the meeting open.

sections.heading: Financial statements
paragraphs: The financial statements for the financial year ended {{.F.fy_end}}, with the statement by the directors, were received and adopted.
There being no other business, the chair declared the meeting closed.
